collection_notes: NAME DISCREPANCY: inventory name is "Joy VanDervort Fields" (from the Washington County certified-candidates PDF). Her pamphlet statement prints only "Joy Fields"; the Nov 2026 Multnomah pamphlet Candidate Index prints "Joy VanDevort Fields"; the guide file is named wmswcd_zone_5_joy_fields. Ballot spelling of the middle/maiden name (VanDervort vs VanDevort) is unresolved and should be checked against the certified ballot. Searches used "Joy Fields" (step 5 with soil water Multnomah). Not on the board roster. WMSWCD board page lists Zone 5 Terri Preeg Riggsby (Chair, term ends Dec 2026), Zone 4 Vacant, At Large Position 2 Shawn Looney (term ends Dec 2026), and Ronda Zakocs as an appointed Associate Director (2026-present).
